offerings.name: Web search (Responses API `web_search` tool)
offerings.pricing: $10.00 / 1k calls + Search content tokens billed at model rates
offerings.output_type: 带内联引用的答案文本 + `web_search_call` 输出项(action: search/open_page/find_in_page、sources、图片结果)
offerings.note: 搜索上下文上限128k；支持 filters(各100个域名)、search_context_size(low/medium/high)、external_web_access、user_location；tool_choice 为 auto 时搜索可选。

offerings.name: Image Web search (Responses API `web_search` with `search_content_types: ["image"]`)
offerings.pricing: $10.00 / 1k calls + Search content tokens billed at model rates
offerings.output_type: 图片结果(image_result: image_url/source_website_url/thumbnail_url/caption)，随文本结果分开返回
offerings.note: 用 image_settings.max_results 与 caption 控制；需 include: ["web_search_call.results"] 才能读原始图片结果。

offerings.name: Web search preview (reasoning models, including `gpt-5`, o-series)
offerings.pricing: $10.00 / 1k calls + Search content tokens billed at model rates
offerings.output_type: 带 url_citation 注解的答案文本
offerings.note: 遗留工具：不支持 filters 与 return_token_budget，并忽略 external_web_access；新集成应迁移到 web_search。

offerings.name: Web search preview (non-reasoning models)
offerings.pricing: $25.00 / 1k calls + Search content tokens are free
offerings.free_quota: Search content tokens are free（搜索内容 token 免费）
offerings.output_type: 带 url_citation 注解的答案文本
offerings.note: 遗留工具，建议迁移到 Responses API `web_search`。

offerings.name: `gpt-5-search-api` (Chat Completions 搜索模型)
offerings.pricing: 按 token 计费：输入 $1.25 / 1M tokens，缓存输入 $0.125 / 1M，输出 $10.00 / 1M tokens
offerings.price_basis: Specialized models / Search, Standard, 每 1M tokens
offerings.output_type: 带引用的答案文本（Chat Completions 搜索模型路径）
offerings.note: 上下文 200k；不支持域名过滤、完整来源列表、实时访问控制与 token 预算控制；响应前总是先搜索。gpt-4o/mini-search-preview 已弃用，2026-07-23 停用。
